thread:
maya: Heads up — we're getting more ad-hoc requests from product teams to pull SIEM extracts for vuln triage. Need a crisp runbook for analyst entitlements + KMS unwrap approvals so we don't accidentally widen long-term access. Any existing playbook or can we draft one? :eyes:

elena: +1. We chatted about this briefly last quarter but never formalized. Key constraints: JIT unwrapping only, ticket + manager approval, scoped export window (timebox), and mandatory masking/scrubbing steps before export leaves the SOC environment.

carter: I'd add RBAC change process: temporary role assignment to "siem-analyst-jit" for X hours via our identity service. Role has no key-unwrapping perms by default; we grant via a separate KMS-approval flow.

simon: Also record an audit event that ties the unwrap to the ticket ID and the oncall approver. Elastic/Splunk should ingest that event as "kms:decrypt_requested" with metadata: requester, ticket, ttl.

maya: Good. Can we sketch the minimal ticket template? Product needs fast turnaround but we must enforce guardrails.

elena: Suggested ticket template (use in ops):

```
Title: [JIT SIEM EXTRACT] <team> - <short reason>
Description: brief justification + severity
Time window requested: 2026-03-21T10:00Z -> 2026-03-21T12:00Z
Fields required: list of fields (explicit)
Scrubbing required: yes/no (if yes, list)
Data residency constraints: (e.g., PII redaction, EU-only)
Approver: SOC lead / security manager
Return/expiry: auto delete after 30d / deliver masked CSV only
Ticket ID: INC-#####
```

carter: For RBAC changes: make the request in IAM with label ticket=INC-#####. The automation will pick that label and grant the temporary role for 4h by default. Anything >8h needs escalation.

infra-bot: "Audit event created: audit:kms_unwrap_request, ticket=INC-24109, requester=maya, status=pending_approver"

oncall: Approver flow proposal: SOC lead gets a Slack DM with one-click approve that calls the KMS proxy to create ephemeral key access. Approve -> infra grants "kms:unwrap:ticket-INC-#####" scoped token visible in audit only. Reject -> auto explain to requester.

simon: Retention / export TTL rules:
- Raw export copies stored in secure bucket: TTL 30 days (short-lived)
- For forensic evidence: can request evidence retention up to 365 days with legal signoff
- Default: exports must be masked to remove full strings of PII; if exact values are needed, require red-team-level justification and legal OK

maya: What about logs that contain secrets or tokens? We should have a pre-export scrub step and a blocking rule on exports that contain regex patterns for private keys, AWS credentials, etc.

elena: Agreed. Add automated pre-flight scan using the existing DLP job. If DLP flags, block and route to security for manual review. Example check command we call: `scripts/scan_export.sh --file export.csv` (returns non-zero on finding secrets).

carter: Implementation details for KMS: don't give raw key material. Use a KMS-proxy endpoint that returns a single-use unwrapped artifact only to the exporter process, and attach `ticket_id` and `expiry`. Proxy logs unwraps to an immutable audit index.

maya: How do we prove we didn't leak? What are the audit artifacts we store?

simon: Minimal audit artifacts: requester, approver, ticket id, unwrap start ts, unwrap end ts, object checksum, export bucket path, and the DLP scan result. Store in encrypted audit index with 7-year retention for compliance. Access to that index is highly restricted (read only for security lead + legal).

elena: Ops checklist for approver (short):
1) Confirm ticket text + scope
2) Verify requester identity in Okta
3) Ensure fields requested are minimal
4) Confirm scrub plan and DLP pass
5) Click approve -> ephemeral role + KMS proxy is allowed for N hours

oncall: Quick sample approval flow payload we use in the DM button (for engineers):
```
POST /internal/approvals
{
  "ticket": "INC-24109",
  "action": "approve",
  "ttl": "4h",
  "scope": ["export-read:/siem/alerts/2026-03-21"]
}
```

maya: Can someone write a short runbook doc we can link from the ticket template? I'm happy to author. Need to include: request flow, RBAC mapping, KMS proxy details, DLP requirements, audit fields, retention defaults, escalation contacts.

carter: I can PR the RBAC role definitions and the automation hook this week.

elena: I'll draft the runbook. We'll keep default export TTL 30d and make longer retention an explicit opt-in with legal.

infra-bot: "Saved draft runbook: /docs/security/siem_jit_runbook.md (draft) — updated by elena — link: https://go/repo/siem_jit_runbook (internal)"

maya: Awesome. Final ask: add a small regression test that simulates the flow (request -> approve -> unwrap -> export -> dlp scan) in CI so we don't accidentally break it. Anyone own that?

carter: I'll add the test to infra-ci under `tests/siem_jit_flow_test.py`. ETA EOD Friday.

elena: I'll open the PR for the runbook and include the ticket template + sample Slack buttons.

maya: Thanks all. Once PRs land we'll spin up a quick tabletop with SOC to exercise the flow. :lock:
